source: The Supabase CLI release the operator's workstation runs through Homebrew, published at https://github.com/supabase/cli/releases/tag/v2.114.0. A schema release's post-build test starts a scratch database with it and its delivery pushes with it, and a Linux builder carries no Supabase CLI of its own, so every host that runs either installs this release from its GitHub release, verified against the release's checksums.txt; a newer release is adopted by changing it here.
